summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial Video: Topology Process p03 Preparation Before Zbrush Sculpting ## Reshaping the Clothing Model After inserting the model of the top, we first reshape the clothing. ## Dividing the Model According to UV We can divide the model according to the UV. ## Adding Seam Effects We can cover the edge of the model and then use the expansion in the deformation tool to add the seam effect. ## Using Morph to Erase Unnecessary Seams We can also add Morph first to erase the unnecessary seam. ### Repetition of Morph Application It is important to note that we can apply Morph multiple times to effectively remove unnecessary seams. > **Note:** The instruction "We can add Morph first to erase the unnecessary seam" was repeated multiple times to emphasize its importance in the preparation process. ## Using 拋光 to Remove Uneven Parts You can use 拋光 (polishing) to remove uneven parts. This tool is essential for achieving a smooth finish in your model. ## Conclusion Thank you for watching. ```
